messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "seek emergency medical attention"
set: ["seek emergency medical attention", "caregiver should seek emergency medical attention", "emergency medical attention", "seek emergency medical attention for coughing up blood", "seek emergency medical attention for blood in urine", "seek emergency medical attention for black or bloody stools", "seek emergency medical attention or call your doctor right away", "seek emergency medical attention for bleeding that will not stop", "contact doctor or seek emergency medical attention for uncontrolled bleeding", "seek emergency medical attention for vomiting that looks like coffee grounds", "seek emergency medical attention or call poison help line at 1-800-222-1222", "medical emergency", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if fall or hit head", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if bleeding will not stop", "seek emergency medical attention if you have symptoms such as chest pain or pressure", "seek medical attention if breathing problems get worse quickly"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "caregiver should seek emergency medical attention",

  ],
  "alias": "seek emergency medical attention"
}
